decision.summary: Two regions stand out: (1) an abrupt multi-sample offset in N/E around indices 485–492 with unclear recovery, and (2) a prolonged, noisy descent in E/U starting at 605, punctuated by missing samples and extreme values, lacking a clear opposing return.

regions.observation: Sharp multi-sample drop in N and E components around index 486–488, with U showing a concurrent but smaller offset; the drop appears abrupt and sustained over ~3 samples before partial recovery—suggestive of a possible temporary offset or jump with ambiguous return.

Extended region beginning near index 607 with large negative excursions in E (down to -7.34) and U (up to +2.41), including missing samples at 610–611; the pattern shows a steep descent followed by irregular fluctuations without clear platform or symmetric return—warrants closer inspection for superposed motion or data artifact.
